description: DD-Only overlay (DD_START=10%, DD_FULL=25%, MIN_EXP=30%) on CR08+D01 crowding defense base. No VT.

gate0_pit.c1_full_sample: PASS - DD brake uses expanding cummax/cumprod, no full-sample stats
gate0_pit.c2_same_day_circular: PASS - dd_lag = c(0, dd_pct[-n_f]) provides 1-day lag

gate1_performance.assessment: FAIL - Worst SR among all variants (0.566). CAGR 6.91% below target. MDD 26.9% exceeds 25%. IR most negative of all variants (-0.124). DD-only without VT fails to control vol, resulting in higher vol (12.21% vs s5's 11.89%) without compensating return.

gate3_role_honesty.assessment: Diversifier role is honest given negative IR and sub-benchmark risk-adjusted returns.

gate4_statistical.assessment: FAIL - WORST OOS retention of all variants: 15.8% (IS 0.726 -> OOS 0.114). Alpha almost completely decayed: recent 3Y SR 0.119 (ratio 0.21 vs full). This variant shows the most severe alpha exhaustion in the family.

gate5_ff5.assessment: Not run. SR 0.566 makes FF5 alpha virtually impossible.

s3_orthogonality_review.assessment: POOR - Inherited from base. Factor redundancy unaddressed.

mutation_comparison.vs_m2: M1 (SR 0.566) < M2 (SR 0.646). M1 uses wider DD band (10/25 vs 5/15) but no VT. Worse in every metric except MDD which is similar.
mutation_comparison.assessment: DD-only approach is strictly inferior to VT+DD combinations. Removing VT increases vol without benefit. The wider DD band (10/25) activates later and less aggressively than M2 (5/15), resulting in worse MDD control.

rejection_reasons: Factor redundancy: CR08-D01 corr=0.943 (inherited, fundamental flaw)
Worst SR in family: 0.566 (below even the unoptimized base 0.633)
Most severe alpha decay: recent 3Y SR 0.119 (ratio 0.21)
Worst OOS retention: 15.8% (near-complete alpha loss out-of-sample)
DD-only mutation rationale unsound: removing VT increases vol without compensating
overall_verdict.summary: STR_1422_s5_m1 (DD-only 10/25) is PIT-clean but the weakest variant in the family. Removing VT and using only a DD brake with wide thresholds (10%/25%) produces the worst SR (0.566), worst OOS retention (15.8%), and worst alpha decay (ratio 0.21). The mutation hypothesis -- that a simpler DD-only overlay might be more robust -- is disproven. The underlying problem remains: CR08+D01 factor pair has 0.943 correlation, making the signal effectively single-factor with insufficient alpha.
